1. Main results

The main section introduces the central theorem and its proof. The fixture's purpose is to verify that the chunker emits chunks in document order even when an appendix follows the main sections.

Theorem 1.1 (Main result).

Every finitely generated module over a principal ideal domain is a direct sum of cyclic modules.

Proof.

Apply the structure theorem from Section 2 of the appendix. The argument is by Smith normal form.

2. Appendix: Smith normal form

The appendix records the auxiliary lemma used in Section 1. Order matters: the chunker must emit Section 1 chunks before Section 2 chunks, even though "Appendix" labels are alphabetically earlier than "Main results" in some collations.

Lemma 2.1 (Smith normal form).

Every matrix with entries in a principal ideal domain is equivalent to a diagonal matrix via row and column operations.

Proof.

Standard; see any algebra textbook.
